# Shift4 Completes Acquisition of Paramount Commerce


Nov 24, 2026 8:30 AM EST[Download as PDF](https://d1io3yog0oux5.cloudfront.net/_998ec3ff3f4286e92c2dd8f3b8f23b41/shift4/news/2026-11-24_Shift4_Completes_Acquisition_of_Paramount_312.pdf)


*The acquisition expands Shift4's Canadian presence with one of the first Payment Service Providers to become an Interac e-Transfer® Participant and one of the first direct participants of Canada's Real-Time Rail (RTR), while adding specialized gaming expertise.*


CENTER VALLEY, Pa. & TORONTO--(BUSINESS WIRE)--[Shift4](http://www.shift4.com/) (NYSE: FOUR), the global commerce technology provider powering the experience economy, today announced the successful completion of its acquisition of Paramount Commerce Group ("Paramount Commerce"), Canada's leading pay-by-bank provider.


Paramount Commerce specializes in real-time account-to-account payment processing for high-growth verticals. Paramount Commerce recently became one of the first payment service providers to become a Participant in the Interac e-Transfer service and one of the first direct participants of Canada's Real-Time Rail (RTR), enabling Paramount Commerce to deliver faster, lower-friction payment flows with complete operational control.


Through this transaction, Shift4 broadens its payment ecosystem by acquiring Paramount Commerce and its real-time account-to-account payment capabilities. This complements Shift4's innovation across the experience economy, including same-day tip payouts (Dine), lower-cost settlement on high-ticket bookings (Stay), and pay-by-bank for season tickets and premium suites (Play).


"This is a textbook Shift4 acquisition that fits squarely into our playbook: acquiring specialized technology and deep vertical expertise to enhance our global platform and expand our customer base," said Shift4 CEO Taylor Lauber. "Paramount Commerce has built the premier pay-by-bank solution in Canada, with deep roots in gaming — one of the most demanding corners of the experience economy. By leveraging their expertise, we will enhance our account-to-account offering across North America and Europe to give enterprise merchants a faster, frictionless way to accept payments and provide their customers the seamless experience they expect."


The acquisition reinforces Shift4's ongoing expansion efforts, enhancing its pay-by-bank offering while opening new opportunities to deliver its end-to-end acquiring capabilities around the world. Paramount Commerce's instant account-to-account capabilities complement the payout capabilities Shift4 gained through prior acquisitions of Global Blue and Bambora.


**About Shift4**


Shift4 (NYSE: FOUR) powers the experience economy, enabling businesses to deliver the moments that matter. Transforming how people shop, dine, stay, and play, Shift4's commerce technology allows for a seamless experience at any scale. From your neighborhood restaurant to the world’s largest event venues, Shift4 handles billions of transactions annually for hundreds of thousands of businesses around the world.
